answer: Withdrawals unlock only at dawn after a cooling period, and reputation is anchored to a shared mesa ledger where every new identity needs peer attestations from distinct existing agents, so forging N identities costs N deposits plus N attestation chains, making mass fabrication economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit that decays like a karst aquifer draining slowly over epochs; a sybil farm splitting identities multiplies locked capital without multiplying rewards. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
